questions.work: Area: $\frac{1}{2} \cdot 6 \cdot 5 = 15$. Cost: $15 \cdot 4 = 60$.

questions.q: The perimeter of this rhombus is 40 cm. What is its area?
questions.work: All four sides are equal, so each side is $40 \div 4 = 10$. Then $A = bh = 10 \cdot 7 = 70$.

questions.work: Rectangle: $10 \cdot 6 = 60$. Each triangle is $(18 - 10) \div 2 = 4$ wide, so each is $\frac{1}{2} \cdot 6 \cdot 4 = 12$. Then $60 + 12 + 12 = 84$.
